python3 -c '
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect("customers.db")
ok = True

# 1. File-level integrity
ic = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check")]
print("integrity_check:", ic)
ok &= ic == ["ok"]

# 2. Table exists
tables = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\"table\"")]
print("tables:", tables)
ok &= "customers" in tables

# 3. Schema matches expected definition
cols = [(r[1], r[2], r[5]) for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(customers)")]
print("schema (name, type, pk):", cols)
expected = [("id", "INTEGER", 1), ("name", "TEXT", 0), ("email", "TEXT", 0), ("city", "TEXT", 0)]
ok &= cols == expected

# 4. Row count + expected ids
n = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers").fetchone()[0]
ids = sorted(r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT id FROM customers"))
print("row count:", n, "| ids:", ids)
ok &= n == 4 and ids == [1, 2, 3, 4]

# 5. No NULLs in any column
nulls = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE id IS NULL OR name IS NULL OR email IS NULL OR city IS NULL").fetchone()[0]
print("rows with NULL values:", nulls)
ok &= nulls == 0

conn.close()
print("\nRESULT:", "CONSISTENT - all checks passed" if ok else "INCONSISTENT - see above")
'
